sentences.en: Those children were covered with dirt from head to foot.
sentences.zh: 那些孩子从头到脚都是灰尘。

sentences.en: Many people use bicycles for transportation on the dirt roads.
sentences.zh: 许多人使用自行车在尘土飞扬的路上行驶。

sentences.en: Sami planted the flower in a cup of dirt.
sentences.zh: 萨米在一个装满泥土的杯子里种了一朵花。

senses.zh: 污垢，灰尘，脏土 - 泥土，散土 - 下流想法；下流话 - 恶言，丑闻
